text: What if your landlord's biggest competitor was helping set your rent?
They're supposed to compete for tenants.
But according to the U.S. Justice Department, some landlords fed private rent and vacancy data into the same pricing software.
That software had a name: RealPage.
It used competitors' information to recommend rental prices.
The government alleged this weakened competition.
It sued RealPage, which later agreed to restrictions on how its software uses competitors' data.
The same software recommending their prices.
